title: A comparer for anything smaller
prompt: Implement `class Box { public int Weight; }` and a contravariant comparer adapter: `static IComparer<Box> ByWeight() => Comparer<Box>.Create((x, y) => x.Weight.CompareTo(y.Weight));` in class `Solution`. Then use it: `static void Sort(List<Box> boxes)` sorts by Weight ascending in place using the comparer.

tests.name: sort
tests.hint: Comparer<T>.Create builds an IComparer<T> from a lambda; List<T>.Sort(comparer) sorts in place.
